question:
Analise o(s) documento(s) de cenário do projeto e gere o SRS completo no formato especificado, seguindo o processo de trabalho: buscas dedicadas na base de conhecimento para cada tipo de artefato, rastreabilidade validada entre os artefatos.

Documento(s) de cenário:
--- Project Scenario 8.pdf ---
BECS (Book E-Commerce System)
So basically what we're trying to do is get books selling 
online instead of however you guys are doing it now, just a 
simple site where people can come in, look through what's 
available, throw a few books in a cart and check out. Nothing 
crazy, I just want it to actually work and not be a headache 
to keep up with. Right now I think it's all kind of manual or 
scattered and there's no real way for someone to just browse 
and buy without someone in the middle handling it, so that's 
the itch we're trying to scratch here. 
 
Anybody coming to the site should be able to just make an 
account, that's it, no big verification process or anything, 
and once they're in they can search for books and see title, 
author, price, add stuff to their cart and go through 
checkout. Keep the search simple, just matching on the title 
and it has to be exact, nothing fancy like partial matches or 
letting people search by author, that's more than we need 
right now. Some of these people might want to sign up to get 
notified about promotions and deals, so let's call those folks 
members, and they're the ones who can use promo codes when 
they check out. I picture this being pretty bare-bones in 
terms of who can buy what, like one copy of each book per 
order is plenty, we don't need people stacking ten copies of 
the same thing in their cart. 
 
On my side of things, I need a way to manage the inventory, 
basically a login that lets me add new books, edit prices, see 
how much stock I've got, that kind of stuff. I also want the 
system to ping me, like an email or something, whenever a book 
is running low so I don't get caught without stock, unless 
I've told it not to bother for that particular book because 
maybe I'm discontinuing it. And I want to be able to set up 
these percentage-off promotions every now and then and have it 
just email all the members automatically when I create one. 
 
One thing I want to be upfront about, we don't need to 
actually process real credit cards or handle real money 
movement right now, just collect the card number as part of 
the checkout flow and spit out a receipt and keep a log of 
what was purchased, who bought it, when. The real payment 
processing piece is something for way later, not part of this. 
Same with security stuff, I know that sounds bad, but honestly 
for what we need right now I'm not worried about encryption or 
people forgetting passwords or whatever, that's not a 
priority, let's not spend time building password recovery or 
anything like that for now. 
 
There's only going to be one person managing the store, me 
basically, so don't worry about building out roles for 
multiple managers or anything fancy like that, and a manager 
should never also be a regular customer account, those are two 
separate hats. It just needs to run somewhere people can get 
to it through a normal browser, nothing exotic on the 
technical side, just something stable that people in here can 
pull up and use without issues.

Sistema: BECS (Book E-Commerce System)

Resumo executivo: The BECS is a browser-based book e-commerce system that enables customers to register, search for available books by exact title, manage a shopping cart, complete checkout, receive receipts, and access promotion benefits as members. It also provides the store manager with inventory, promotion, low-stock notification, and purchase-log capabilities, reducing manual intermediation in book sales.

Escopo: The BECS enables customers to browse and purchase books online while allowing one store manager to maintain inventory and promotions.
  Em escopo: Customer account registration and authentication
  Em escopo: Member subscription to promotion notifications
  Em escopo: Book browsing and exact-title search
  Em escopo: Shopping cart management
  Em escopo: Checkout with card-number collection
  Em escopo: Receipt generation
  Em escopo: Purchase logging
  Em escopo: Inventory management
  Em escopo: Low-stock notifications
  Em escopo: Percentage-off promotion management
  Em escopo: Promotion notification to members
  Em escopo: Browser-based access
  Fora de escopo: Real credit-card authorization or payment settlement — explicitly deferred to a future version
  Fora de escopo: Password recovery — explicitly excluded from the current version
  Fora de escopo: Encryption implementation — explicitly excluded from the current scope
  Fora de escopo: Partial-title or author-based search — not required for the current version
  Fora de escopo: Multiple copies of the same book in one order — business policy limits each book to one copy per order
  Fora de escopo: Multiple manager roles or permission levels — only one manager is required
  Fora de escopo: Using the same account as both manager and regular customer — explicitly prohibited
  Premissa: PA-01: Customers have access to a standard web browser and an Internet connection. [INFERRED]
  Premissa: PA-02: An email delivery mechanism is available for low-stock and promotion notifications. [INFERRED]
  Premissa: PA-03: The store has one designated manager account. [INFERRED]
  Restrição: REST-01 (Escopo): Real payment processing is excluded from this version.
  Restrição: REST-02 (Segurança): Encryption and password recovery are excluded from this version.
  Restrição: REST-03 (Acesso): The system must be accessible through a standard web browser.
  Restrição: REST-04 (Organizacional): Only one manager is supported.
  Restrição: REST-05 (Contas): Manager and customer accounts must remain separate.

Stakeholders:
  STK-01 - Customer (Usuário primário): Register an account, authenticate, browse books, search by exact title, manage a cart, check out, receive a receipt, and review the purchase result.
  STK-02 - Member (Usuário primário): Receive promotion notifications and use valid promotion codes during checkout.
  STK-03 - Store Manager (Usuário primário): Authenticate separately, manage books and prices, inspect inventory, configure low-stock notifications, create promotions, notify members, and inspect purchase records.
  STK-04 - Email Delivery Service (Stakeholder externo): Receive notification requests and deliver low-stock and promotion messages to their intended recipients.

Regras de negócio:
  RN-001 - Exact-title search: A book search matches only the complete book title; partial-title and author-based searches are not included.
  RN-002 - One copy per book per order: An order may contain no more than one copy of each distinct book.
  RN-003 - Member promotion eligibility: Only customers registered as members may use promotion codes during checkout.
  RN-004 - Low-stock notification exception: A low-stock notification is issued when a book reaches its configured low-stock condition, unless notifications are disabled for that book.
  RN-005 - Separate account categories: A manager account and a regular customer account represent separate account categories and cannot be used as the same account.
  RN-006 - Deferred payment processing: The store collects card information for checkout records but does not authorize or settle payments in this version.
  RN-007 - Percentage-off promotions: A promotion applies a percentage discount defined by the manager to eligible checkout items.
  RN-008 - Purchase record contents: A completed purchase record contains the purchased books, buyer identification, and purchase date and time.

Requisitos funcionais:
  RF-001 - Customer account registration: The system must allow a visitor to create a customer account using the registration data defined for the system. [Must have]
  RF-002 - Customer authentication: The system must authenticate a customer using the credentials associated with a customer account. [Must have]
  RF-003 - Book catalog browsing: The system must display the available books in the catalog. [Must have]
  RF-004 - Book information display: The system must display the title, author, and price of a selected book. [Must have]
  RF-005 - Exact-title search: The system must return books whose complete title exactly matches the submitted search text. [Must have]
  RF-006 - Book cart addition: The system must add a selected available book to the customer's cart. [Must have]
  RF-007 - Cart consultation: The system must display the books currently contained in the customer's cart. [Must have]
  RF-008 - Checkout card collection: The system must collect the card number submitted during checkout without initiating payment processing. [Must have]
  RF-009 - Checkout completion: The system must create a purchase when a customer submits a valid checkout. [Must have]
  RF-010 - Receipt generation: The system must generate a receipt after a purchase is created. [Must have]
  RF-011 - Purchase logging: The system must record the purchased books, buyer, and purchase date and time. [Must have]
  RF-012 - Member enrollment: The system must allow a customer to enroll as a member for promotion notifications. [Should have]
  RF-013 - Promotion code application: The system must apply a valid promotion code to a checkout made by a member. [Should have]
  RF-014 - Manager authentication: The system must authenticate the store manager through the manager account. [Must have]
  RF-015 - Book creation: The system must allow the store manager to add a book to the catalog. [Must have]
  RF-016 - Book price editing: The system must allow the store manager to edit the price of an existing book. [Must have]
  RF-017 - Inventory consultation: The system must display the current stock quantity for each managed book. [Must have]
  RF-018 - Low-stock alert configuration: The system must allow the manager to enable or disable low-stock notifications for an individual book. [Should have]
  RF-019 - Low-stock notification: The system must send an email notification when an enabled book reaches its low-stock condition. [Should have]
  RF-020 - Promotion creation: The system must allow the manager to create a promotion with a percentage discount. [Should have]
  RF-021 - Member promotion notification: The system must email all members when the manager creates a promotion. [Should have]
  RF-022 - Purchase-log consultation: The system must allow the manager to consult purchase records. [Should have]
  RF-023 - Inventory reduction: The system must reduce the stock quantity of each book included in a completed purchase by one unit. [Must have]

Requisitos não funcionais:
  RNF-001 (Performance Efficiency) - The system must respond to catalog browsing and exact-title search requests within 2 seconds at the 95th percentile. [TBD] | Métrica: At least 95% of catalog and search responses complete within 2 seconds under 100 concurrent users. [TBD]
  RNF-002 (Compatibility) - The system must operate through the current versions of Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari. [TBD] | Métrica: 0 critical defects in the core customer and manager flows on the four supported browsers. [TBD]
  RNF-003 (Reliability) - The system must provide monthly availability of at least 99%. [TBD] | Métrica: Unplanned downtime must not exceed 7 hours and 26 minutes per calendar month. [TBD]
  RNF-004 (Interaction Capability) - A customer without prior system training must complete registration, book selection, cart review, and checkout within 10 minutes. [TBD] | Métrica: At least 80% of five representative participants complete the defined flow within 10 minutes. [TBD]
  RNF-005 (Reliability) - The system must persist a completed purchase record without loss after checkout confirmation. | Métrica: 100% of 100 test purchases remain retrievable after transaction completion. [TBD]
  RNF-006 (Maintainability) - The business logic must have automated test coverage of at least 70%. [TBD] | Métrica: Line coverage of at least 70% in the business layer. [TBD]

Histórias de usuário:
  HU-001 - Como customer, quero create and use an account, para purchase books without manual assistance
  HU-002 - Como customer, quero search for a book by its exact title, para locate the desired book in the catalog
  HU-003 - Como customer, quero add an available book to my cart, para prepare an order for checkout
  HU-004 - Como customer, quero complete checkout and receive a receipt, para obtain a record of my purchase
  HU-005 - Como customer, quero become a member, para receive promotion notifications and use promotion codes
  HU-006 - Como store manager, quero manage books and prices, para keep the catalog and inventory information current
  HU-007 - Como store manager, quero receive low-stock notifications, para replenish books before they become unavailable
  HU-008 - Como store manager, quero create percentage-off promotions, para offer deals to members
  HU-009 - Como store manager, quero consult purchase records, para know what was purchased, by whom, and when

Casos de uso:
  UC-001 - Register customer account | Ator: Customer
    1. The customer opens the registration form.
    2. The customer submits the required registration data.
    3. The system validates the data.
    4. The system creates the customer account.
    5. The system confirms account creation.
  UC-002 - Search for a book | Ator: Customer
    1. The customer enters a complete book title.
    2. The customer submits the search.
    3. The system compares the text with book titles.
    4. The system displays matching books.
  UC-003 - Add a book to the cart | Ator: Customer
    1. The customer selects an available book.
    2. The customer selects the add-to-cart action.
    3. The system adds one copy of the book.
    4. The system displays the updated cart.
  UC-004 - Complete checkout | Ator: Customer
    1. The customer opens checkout.
    2. The system displays the cart contents.
    3. The customer enters the card number.
    4. The customer submits checkout.
    5. The system creates and logs the purchase.
    6. The system generates a receipt.
  UC-005 - Enroll as a member | Ator: Customer
    1. The customer selects membership enrollment.
    2. The system records the membership status.
    3. The system confirms enrollment.
  UC-006 - Manage inventory | Ator: Store Manager
    1. The manager opens inventory management.
    2. The manager adds a book or selects an existing book.
    3. The manager enters or changes the book data.
    4. The system validates the data.
    5. The system saves the inventory data.
  UC-007 - Receive a low-stock notification | Ator: Store Manager
    1. The system detects the book's stock condition.
    2. The system checks whether notifications are enabled.
    3. The system creates a low-stock notification.
    4. The system sends the notification to the manager.
  UC-008 - Create a promotion | Ator: Store Manager
    1. The manager opens promotion management.
    2. The manager enters the promotion percentage.
    3. The system validates the percentage.
    4. The system creates the promotion.
    5. The system emails all members.
  UC-009 - Consult purchase records | Ator: Store Manager
    1. The manager opens the purchase log.
    2. The system retrieves recorded purchases.
    3. The system displays the purchase details.

Critérios de aceite:
  CA-001 - Dado A visitor has entered valid registration data, quando the visitor submits the registration form, então the system creates exactly one customer account and displays an account-created confirmation
  CA-002 - Dado A customer account exists with valid credentials, quando the customer submits those credentials, então the system authenticates the customer and displays the customer area
  CA-003 - Dado The catalog contains available books, quando a customer opens the catalog, então the system displays every available book returned by the catalog query
  CA-004 - Dado A book exists in the catalog, quando the customer selects the book, então the system displays its title, author, and price
  CA-005 - Dado The catalog contains a book titled exactly 'Example Book', quando the customer searches for 'Example Book', então the system returns that book and does not return books whose titles do not exactly match
  CA-006 - Dado The selected book has stock greater than zero, quando the customer selects add to cart, então the cart contains the selected book with quantity 1
  CA-007 - Dado The customer has added one book, quando the customer opens the cart, então the system displays that book and quantity 1
  CA-008 - Dado The customer is on the checkout page, quando the customer enters a card number, então the system stores the submitted card number as checkout data and does not call a payment authorization service
  CA-009 - Dado The cart contains available books and required checkout data is valid, quando the customer confirms checkout, então the system creates exactly one purchase record
  CA-010 - Dado A purchase has been created, quando checkout processing finishes, então the system generates a receipt containing the purchase identifier and purchased books
  CA-011 - Dado A purchase has been completed, quando the system saves the purchase, então the record contains the purchased books, buyer, and date and time
  CA-012 - Dado An authenticated customer is not a member, quando the customer enrolls in promotion notifications, então the customer membership status changes to member
  CA-013 - Dado The customer is a member and has a valid promotion code, quando the customer submits the code during checkout, então the system applies the configured percentage discount to the checkout total
  CA-014 - Dado A valid manager account exists, quando the manager submits the manager credentials, então the system authenticates the manager and displays inventory management
  CA-015 - Dado The manager has entered valid book data, quando the manager saves the new book, então the system creates exactly one catalog book
  CA-016 - Dado An existing book and a valid new price are available, quando the manager saves the price change, então the system displays the new price for that book
  CA-017 - Dado A managed book has a recorded stock quantity, quando the manager opens inventory, então the system displays the recorded quantity for that book
  CA-018 - Dado The manager is viewing an existing book, quando the manager disables low-stock notifications, então the system stores the notification status as disabled for that book
  CA-019 - Dado A book has enabled notifications and reaches its low-stock condition, quando the system evaluates the stock condition, então the system sends one low-stock email to the manager
  CA-020 - Dado The manager has entered a valid percentage discount, quando the manager saves the promotion, então the system creates one promotion with the submitted percentage
  CA-021 - Dado A promotion has been created and three members are registered, quando promotion creation completes, então the system submits three promotion emails to the email delivery service
  CA-022 - Dado At least one purchase record exists, quando the manager opens the purchase log, então the system displays the buyer, purchased books, and date and time for each returned record
  CA-023 - Dado A completed purchase contains one copy of a book with stock quantity 5, quando the purchase is saved, então the stock quantity for that book becomes 4
  CA-024 - Dado The system is under the defined concurrent-user load, quando a catalog or exact-title search request is submitted, então at least 95% of responses complete within 2 seconds
  CA-025 - Dado The system is accessed using a supported browser, quando the customer and manager core flows are executed, então no critical defect prevents completion of those flows
  CA-026 - Dado A calendar month has ended, quando availability is calculated, então unplanned downtime is no greater than 7 hours and 26 minutes
  CA-027 - Dado A participant has no prior training, quando the participant performs registration, selection, cart review, and checkout, então at least 80% of participants complete the flow within 10 minutes
  CA-028 - Dado One hundred test purchases have been completed, quando the records are queried after completion, então all 100 purchase records are retrievable
  CA-029 - Dado The business-layer test suite has been executed, quando the coverage report is generated, então the reported line coverage is at least 70%

Glossário:
  Book: A catalog item identified by title, author, price, and stock quantity.
  Customer: A person with a regular account who can browse and purchase books.
  Member: A customer registered to receive promotion notifications and use promotion codes.
  Manager: The single person responsible for inventory, promotions, and purchase-log administration.
  Cart: A temporary collection of books selected by a customer for checkout.
  Promotion code: A code associated with a percentage-off promotion.
  Low-stock condition: The stock condition configured to trigger a notification for a book. [TBD]
  Purchase record: A record containing the purchased books, buyer, and purchase date and time.
  Receipt: A document generated after checkout that confirms the purchase data.

Base: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018 §9.6 · IEEE 830-1998 §3 · Sommerville (2016, cap. 4)
O Documento de Especificação de Requisitos de Software (SRS) é o contrato técnico que descreve o 
que o sistema deve fazer e sob quais condições de qualidade. Ele serve de referência para 
desenvolvedores, testadores, gerentes e clientes durante todo o ciclo de vida do projeto.
1.1 Artefatos Obrigatórios e sua Ordem
Um SRS completo e formal deve conter os seguintes artefatos, nesta ordem:
• ESCOPO: Define o que está DENTRO e FORA do projeto. Evita scope creep.
• STAKEHOLDERS: Lista todos os envolvidos: quem usa, quem financia, quem é afetado.
• PREMISSAS E RESTRIÇÕES: Fatos assumidos como verdadeiros e limites impostos ao projeto.
• REGRAS DE NEGÓCIO (RN): Políticas, fórmulas e condições de negócio que existem independentemente 
do software.
• REQUISITOS FUNCIONAIS (RF): O que o sistema DEVE FAZER — comportamentos, serviços, respostas a 
entradas.
• REQUISITOS NÃO FUNCIONAIS (RNF): Como o sistema deve SER — atributos de qualidade 
quantificáveis.
• HISTÓRIAS DE USUÁRIO (HU): Necessidades na perspectiva do usuário: Como [perfil], quero [ação], para
[benefício].
• CASOS DE USO (UC): Interações detalhadas ator-sistema com fluxo principal, alternativo e exceções.
• CRITÉRIOS DE ACEITE (CA): Condições testáveis em formato BDD (Dado/Quando/Então) que definem 
quando o requisito está concluído.
• GLOSSÁRIO: Termos do domínio com definição precisa para eliminar ambiguidades.
1.2 Como os Artefatos se Interconectam
Os artefatos formam uma cadeia de rastreabilidade. Cada RF deve ter origem em um STK 
(stakeholder) ou RN. Cada HU deve ter pelo menos um RF associado. Cada RF e HU devem ter pelo menos um CA. Esta rastreabilidade garante que nada seja implementado sem justificativa de 
negócio e que tudo que foi prometido seja testável.
Cadeia de rastreabilidade mínima:
STK → (RN →) RF → HU → CA

A ISO/IEC 25010:2023 define 9 características de qualidade do produto. Todo RNF deve ser 
classificado em uma dessas características. A seguir, cada característica com seus sub-atributos e

1. Functional Suitability (Adequação Funcional)
 Functional Completeness — o sistema oferece todas as funções necessárias.
 Functional Correctness — as funções produzem os resultados corretos.
 Functional Appropriateness — as funções facilitam a realização das tarefas.
EXEMPLO — RNF — 1. Functional Suitability
O sistema deve calcular o imposto sobre o valor do pedido aplicando corretamente a alíquota de ICMS 
vigente para o estado de destino, conforme tabela oficial CONFAZ, com variação máxima de R$ 0,01 em 
relação ao valor de referência da Receita Estadual.
2. Performance Efficiency (Eficiência de Desempenho)
 Time Behaviour — tempo de resposta e throughput.
 Resource Utilisation — uso de CPU, memória, rede.
 Capacity — limites máximos suportados.
EXEMPLO — RNF — 2. Performance Efficiency
O sistema deve processar no mínimo 200 pedidos por minuto sob carga de 1.000 usuários simultâneos, com 
tempo de resposta inferior a 2 segundos no percentil 95.
3. Compatibility (Compatibilidade)
 Co-existence — coexiste com outros sistemas sem degradação.
 Interoperability — troca dados com outros sistemas.
EXEMPLO — RNF — 3. Compatibility
A API do sistema deve expor endpoints REST/JSON compatíveis com o padrão OpenAPI 3.0, permitindo 
integração com o ERP legado via OAuth 2.0 sem modificações no ERP.4. Interaction Capability (Capacidade de Interação) — antes 'Usabilidade'
 Appropriateness Recognisability — usuário reconhece a adequação do sistema.
 Learnability — facilidade de aprendizado.
 Operability — facilidade de operação.
 User Error Protection — proteção contra erros do usuário.
 User Engagement — interface envolvente e motivadora.
 Inclusivity — acessível a pessoas com diferentes capacidades.
 User Assistance — suporte ao usuário.
 Self-Descriptiveness — interface autoexplicativa.
EXEMPLO — RNF — 4. Interaction Capability
Um usuário sem treinamento prévio deve ser capaz de registrar seu primeiro pedido completo em até 10 
minutos. A interface deve seguir as diretrizes WCAG 2.1 nível AA.
5. Reliability (Confiabilidade)
 Faultlessness — ausência de falhas em condições normais.
 Availability — proporção de tempo em que o sistema está operacional.
 Fault Tolerance — operação correta mesmo com falhas parciais.
 Recoverability — recuperação após falha.
EXEMPLO — RNF — 5. Reliability
O sistema deve ter disponibilidade mínima de 99,5% ao mês (máx. 3,6h de downtime não planejado). Em 
caso de falha crítica, o sistema deve restaurar a operação normal em até 4 horas (RTO = 4h).

Propósito
O objetivo de Analisar o Estado Atual é compreender as razões pelas quais 
uma corporação precisa mudar algum aspecto de como ela funciona e o que 
seria direta ou indiretamente afetado pela mudança.
Descrição

relaciona com a maneira como a corporação funciona hoje. Define uma linha 
de base e contexto para a mudança.
Entradas
• Resultados de Elicitação: usado para definir e entender o estado atual.

de negócios para melhor entender essas necessidades.

da corporação e relações significativas entre estes elementos.

4.4 Validação dos Requisitos (L2)
A validação dos requisitos é um passo importante para um sistema bem-sucedido (Princípio 
6 em 2). Garantir a qualidade dos requisitos no início reduzirá o desperdício de esforços 
posteriores. Validar os requisitos significa verificar os produtos de trabalho mais disponíveis, 
bem como os requisitos individuais que os mesmos exigem em termos de qualidade (ver 3.8
para detalhes).
Aspectos importantes a serem considerados na validação dos requisitos são:
▪ Envolvimento dos stakeholders certos
▪ Separar a identificação e a correção de defeitos
▪ Validar de diferentes perspectivas
▪ Validações Adicionais
Existem várias técnicas para validação (p. ex., [GiGr1993], [OleA2018]). Estas técnicas de

▪ Walkthrough

Each line is an atomic, checkable claim against the scenario text and the

- Any visitor can create an account with no verification process.
- Logged-in users can search for books by title only, with an exact match (no partial matches, no search by author).
- Users can view a book's title, author, and price, add it to a cart, and check out.
- Only one copy of each book can be purchased per order.
- Members (a subset of registered users) can apply promo codes at checkout.
- The manager (a single login-based account) can add books, edit prices, and view stock levels.
- The system must automatically notify the manager by email when a book's stock is low, unless notifications are disabled for that specific book.
- The manager can create percentage-off promotions; creating one automatically emails all members.
- The system does not process real credit card payments; it only collects a card number, produces a receipt, and logs the purchase (item, buyer, timestamp).
- Encryption and password recovery are explicitly out of scope for this version.
- There is only one manager account; no multi-manager roles are needed.
- A manager account must never also be a regular customer account.
- The system must run as a normal browser-accessible web application, with no exotic technical requirements.

casos_de_uso.pre_condicao: The visitor is not authenticated and does not have a customer account.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_falha: No account is created and validation feedback is displayed.
fluxo_principal: 1. The customer opens the registration form.
2. The customer submits the required registration data.
3. The system validates the data.
4. The system creates the customer account.
5. The system confirms account creation.
fluxos_alternativos: 3a. The customer selects membership during registration → the system records the customer as a member.
fluxos_excecao: 3b. Required data is invalid or incomplete → the system rejects the submission and identifies the invalid fields.

casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: The system displays books whose complete title matches the submitted text.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_falha: The system displays that no exact-title match was found.
fluxo_principal: 1. The customer enters a complete book title.
2. The customer submits the search.
3. The system compares the text with book titles.
4. The system displays matching books.
fluxos_alternativos: 4a. Multiple books have the same title → the system displays all exact matches.
fluxos_excecao: 3a. The search text is empty → the system requests a title before searching.

casos_de_uso.nome: Add a book to the cart
casos_de_uso.pre_condicao: The customer is authenticated and the selected book is available.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: The selected book appears once in the cart.
fluxo_principal: 1. The customer selects an available book.
2. The customer selects the add-to-cart action.
3. The system adds one copy of the book.
4. The system displays the updated cart.
fluxos_alternativos: 3a. The book is already in the cart → the system keeps the quantity at one.
fluxos_excecao: 1a. The book is unavailable → the system prevents addition and displays an availability message.

casos_de_uso.pre_condicao: The customer is authenticated and the cart contains at least one available book.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: A purchase is created, logged, and a receipt is generated.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_falha: No purchase is created and the cart remains available for correction.
fluxo_principal: 1. The customer opens checkout.
2. The system displays the cart contents.
3. The customer enters the card number.
4. The customer submits checkout.
5. The system creates and logs the purchase.
6. The system generates a receipt.
fluxos_alternativos: 3a. The customer enters a valid promotion code and is a member → the system applies the percentage discount.
fluxos_excecao: 4a. Required checkout data is missing → the system rejects checkout and identifies the missing data.
4b. A cart item is no longer available → the system rejects checkout and identifies the unavailable item.

casos_de_uso.pre_condicao: The customer has a customer account.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: The customer is marked as a member.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_falha: The customer's membership status remains unchanged.
fluxo_principal: 1. The customer selects membership enrollment.
2. The system records the membership status.
3. The system confirms enrollment.
fluxos_alternativos: 1a. The customer is already a member → the system displays the current membership status.
fluxos_excecao: 2a. The customer account cannot be updated → the system displays an error and does not change the status.

casos_de_uso.pre_condicao: The manager is authenticated with the manager account.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: The requested book or price information is saved.
fluxo_principal: 1. The manager opens inventory management.
2. The manager adds a book or selects an existing book.
3. The manager enters or changes the book data.
4. The system validates the data.
5. The system saves the inventory data.
fluxos_alternativos: 2a. The manager selects an existing book → the system displays its current data.
fluxos_excecao: 4a. Required book data is invalid → the system rejects the operation and identifies the invalid fields.

casos_de_uso.pre_condicao: A book has low-stock notifications enabled and reaches its low-stock condition.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: A low-stock email is sent to the manager.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_falha: No notification is sent and the event is available for operational review. [INFERRED]
fluxo_principal: 1. The system detects the book's stock condition.
2. The system checks whether notifications are enabled.
3. The system creates a low-stock notification.
4. The system sends the notification to the manager.
fluxos_alternativos: 2a. Notifications are disabled for the book → the system does not send the notification.
fluxos_excecao: 4a. Email delivery fails → the system records the delivery failure. [INFERRED]

casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: A percentage-off promotion is created and members are notified.
fluxo_principal: 1. The manager opens promotion management.
2. The manager enters the promotion percentage.
3. The system validates the percentage.
4. The system creates the promotion.
5. The system emails all members.
fluxos_alternativos: 5a. There are no registered members → the promotion is created without recipient emails.
fluxos_excecao: 3a. The percentage is invalid → the system rejects the promotion and displays a validation message.

casos_de_uso.pre_condicao: The manager is authenticated and purchase records exist.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: The system displays purchase records with buyer, books, and date and time.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_falha: The system displays that no purchase records are available.
fluxo_principal: 1. The manager opens the purchase log.
2. The system retrieves recorded purchases.
3. The system displays the purchase details.
fluxos_alternativos: 2a. The manager applies an available filter → the system displays the matching records. [INFERRED]
fluxos_excecao: 2b. The purchase log cannot be retrieved → the system displays an error and does not alter records.

em_escopo: Account creation for any visitor, with no verification process
Book search by exact title match (logged-in users)
Viewing book title, author, and price
Shopping cart with a limit of one copy per book per order
Checkout flow that collects a card number, generates a receipt, and logs the purchase
Member signup to receive promotion notifications and use promo codes at checkout
Manager login to manage inventory (add books, edit prices, view stock)
Automatic low-stock email alert to the manager, with per-book opt-out
Manager-created percentage-off promotions with automatic email to all members
fora_de_escopo: Real credit card / payment processing — deferred to a later phase
Encryption — not a priority for this version
Password recovery — not a priority for this version
Multiple manager accounts or manager roles — only one manager
Partial/fuzzy search or search by author — title search is exact-match only
Multiple copies of the same book per order — limited to one
premissas: PA-01: Only one person will operate the manager account for the store.
restricoes: REST-01 (Tecnica): The system must be usable through a normal web browser, with no exotic client-side requirements.

stakeholders.descricao: Store Manager — the single account responsible for managing inventory (add books, edit prices, view stock) and creating promotions; must never also be a regular customer account.
Visitor — anyone arriving at the site who can create an account with no verification process.
Registered User / Customer — logged-in user who can search for books, add them to a cart, and check out.
Member — a registered user who opted in to promotion notifications; the only type of user who can apply promo codes at checkout.

regras_de_negocio.descricao: A cart may contain at most one copy of each distinct book per order.
A manager account must never also function as a regular customer account.
Only members (not all registered users) can apply promo codes at checkout.
The low-stock email alert to the manager is suppressed for a given book if the manager has disabled notifications for that specific book.
Creating a new percentage-off promotion automatically triggers an email to all members.

requisitos_funcionais.descricao: The system must allow any visitor to create an account with no verification process.
The system must allow logged-in users to search for books by title using an exact match only (no partial match, no search by author).
The system must display each book's title, author, and price.
The system must allow users to add a book to their shopping cart.
The system must prevent a user from adding more than one copy of the same book to their cart in a single order.
The system must allow users to complete checkout for the items in their cart.
The system must allow a registered user to sign up as a member to receive promotion notifications.
The system must allow members to apply a promo code during checkout.
The system must provide a login for the manager, separate from customer accounts.
The system must allow the manager to add new books to the inventory.
The system must allow the manager to edit the price of existing books.
The system must allow the manager to view current stock levels.
The system must send an email notification to the manager when a book's stock is low, unless notifications are disabled for that book.
The system must allow the manager to create percentage-off promotions.
The system must automatically email all members when a new promotion is created.
The system must collect a card number during checkout without processing an actual payment.
The system must generate a receipt after checkout.
The system must log each purchase, including the item, the buyer, and the timestamp.

requisitos_nao_funcionais.descricao: The system must be usable through a standard web browser, with no exotic or non-standard client-side requirements.

historias_de_usuario.descricao: As a visitor, I want to create an account with no verification process, so that I can start using the site quickly.
As a registered user, I want to search for a book by its exact title, so that I can find the book I'm looking for.
As a registered user, I want to view a book's title, author, and price, so that I can decide whether to buy it.
As a registered user, I want to add a book to my cart, so that I can purchase it later.
As a registered user, I want to check out my cart, so that I can complete my purchase.
As a member, I want to apply a promo code at checkout, so that I can get a discount.
As the manager, I want to add new books and edit their prices, so that I can keep the catalog up to date.
As the manager, I want to be notified when a book's stock is low, so that I can restock in time.
As the manager, I want to create percentage-off promotions, so that I can attract more sales.
As a member, I want to receive an email when a new promotion is created, so that I know about current deals.

casos_de_uso.descricao: Search and Purchase Book — a logged-in user searches for a book by exact title, adds it to the cart, and completes checkout.
Manage Inventory — the manager logs in and adds new books, edits prices, or views current stock levels.
Create Promotion — the manager creates a percentage-off promotion, and the system automatically emails all members.

criterios_de_aceite.descricao: Given a logged-in user, when they search for a book title that exactly matches an existing book, then the system returns that book with its title, author, and price.
Given a user already has one copy of a book in their cart, when they try to add another copy of the same book, then the system prevents the second copy from being added.
Given a member is at checkout with a valid promo code, when they apply the code, then the system applies the corresponding discount.
Given a book's stock drops below the defined threshold and notifications are enabled for that book, when the stock update occurs, then the system sends an email to the manager.
Given the manager creates a new percentage-off promotion, when the promotion is saved, then the system automatically sends an email to all members.
